note_en: Status of every LiteLLM test. Pass criteria are proposed and fixed before each run. To record a run: change the status and add a line to its history.
note_zh: 每項 LiteLLM 測試的狀態。通過標準先訂再測；每次測試後更新狀態並在 history 加一行。

phase1.crit_en: Mean aggregate TPS gain at least 1.3x
phase1.crit_zh: 平均總吞吐至少 1.3 倍
phase1.needs_en: Not like-for-like: AISO1 ran Q4, PRO6000 ran BF16. It shows gateway scaling, not LiteLLM overhead.
phase1.needs_zh: 不是同條件：AISO1 用 Q4、PRO6000 用 BF16。只證明分流，沒量到閘道額外延遲。

history.en: Two smoke runs, NP 4, 100 output tokens: mean x1.73, passed.
history.zh: 兩次 smoke（NP 4、輸出 100 tokens）：平均 ×1.73，通過。

groups.benefit_en: Same cards, with and without LiteLLM, so the gain is honest.
groups.benefit_zh: 同樣的卡，有無 LiteLLM 比一比，數字才公平。

tests.crit_zh: 至少多做 1.3 倍的工作
tests.needs_en: Real machine: PRO6000 GPU1 + GPU7, llama.cpp gemma-4-26B-A4B BF16, 4 slots each, via SSH tunnel from a Mac, 3 repeats, 32 requests per run, 128 tokens. Short replies and one model: treat as a first real measurement, not the final word.
tests.needs_zh: 真機：PRO6000 GPU1＋GPU7，llama.cpp gemma-4-26B-A4B BF16，每張 4 個 slot，從 Mac 經 SSH tunnel 打，重複 3 次，每次 32 個請求、回 128 token。回覆短、只用一個模型：這是第一次真機量測，不是最終結論。

history.en: Tunnel closed; key variable name does not match the config.
history.zh: tunnel 未開；金鑰變數名稱與設定檔不符。

history.en: Pair changed from GPU4+GPU5 (off limits) to GPU6+GPU7. Waiting for the Ray Serve owner to free GPU6. No request sent to any GPU.
history.zh: 成對從 GPU4＋GPU5（不可使用）改為 GPU6＋GPU7。等 Ray Serve 負責人讓出 GPU6。尚未對任何 GPU 送出請求。

history.en: Real run on GPU1 + GPU7 (GPU4/GPU5 off limits, GPU6 held by another PoC). 4 at once: one GPU 264 tokens/s; client round-robin 268 (p95 3329 ms); LiteLLM least-busy 340 (p95 1607 ms) = 1.29x. 8 at once: one GPU 284; round-robin 520; LiteLLM 525 = 1.85x. No failed requests. Mean 1.57x, passes 1.3x. LiteLLM beat round-robin by 27% at 4 at once but only 1% at 8 (both cards full).
history.zh: GPU1＋GPU7 真機測試（GPU4、GPU5 不可使用，GPU6 被另一個 PoC 占用）。同時 4 個：單卡 264 token/s；客戶端輪流 268（p95 3329 ms）；LiteLLM least-busy 340（p95 1607 ms）＝1.29 倍。同時 8 個：單卡 284；輪流 520；LiteLLM 525＝1.85 倍。無失敗請求。平均 1.57 倍，通過 1.3 倍。同時 4 個時 LiteLLM 比輪流多 27%，同時 8 個只多 1%（兩張卡都滿載）。

tests.result_en: Two cards 1.29x at 4 at once, 1.85x at 8. LiteLLM +27% over client round-robin at 4 at once, +1% at 8.
tests.result_zh: 兩張卡：同時 4 個為 1.29 倍，8 個為 1.85 倍。LiteLLM 比客戶端輪流：4 個時多 27%，8 個時多 1%。
tests.why_en: How much faster with two cards?
tests.note_en: Real machine: PRO6000 GPU1 + GPU7, same model. 4 people at once: 1.29x. 8 at once: 1.85x. A first measurement with short answers.
tests.note_zh: 真機：PRO6000 GPU1＋GPU7，同一個模型。4 人同時 1.29 倍，8 人同時 1.85 倍。第一次量測，回答很短。

tests.crit_en: LiteLLM does at least as much work as splitting by hand
tests.crit_zh: LiteLLM 至少不比人工輪流分配差
tests.needs_en: Simulated backends (A 0.2 s, B 0.3 s, each slows 25% per extra request in flight), 16 at once, 3 repeats. The gain comes from load awareness, which an app could build itself; LiteLLM spares every app from doing it. Recheck on real GPUs in 1a.
tests.needs_zh: 模擬後端（A 0.2 秒、B 0.3 秒，每多一個在途請求就慢 25%），同時 16 個，重複 3 次。優勢來自「看負載」，應用程式自己也能做；LiteLLM 的價值是讓每個應用不必各做一遍。要在 1a 用真 GPU 再確認。

history.en: Listed.
history.zh: 已列入。

history.en: Simulated backends, 16 at once, 480 requests, 3 repeats. One backend 16.7 req/s (p95 957 ms); client round-robin 20.7 (p95 1206); LiteLLM least-busy 23.3 (p95 849) = +12% throughput and -30% p95 vs round-robin.
history.zh: 模擬後端，同時 16 個、480 個請求、重複 3 次。單一後端 16.7 req/s（p95 957 ms）；用戶端輪流 20.7（p95 1206）；LiteLLM least-busy 23.3（p95 849），比輪流吞吐 +12%、p95 −30%。

history.en: Relabelled: these numbers come from fake backends on a Mac, not from GPUs. They test the gateway logic only. Real-machine retest is in 1a.
history.zh: 改標：這些數字來自 Mac 上的假後端，不是 GPU，只驗證閘道邏輯。真機重測在 1a。

history.en: Real: 2 PRO6000 GPUs, 3 runs each. LiteLLM 'least busy' vs sending requests to each GPU in turn. An earlier run gave +27% at 4 users and +1% at 8.
history.zh: 真機：PRO6000 兩張 GPU，各跑 3 次。LiteLLM「找最閒的」對比自己輪流送。較早一次測到 4 人 +27%、8 人 +1%。

tests.result_en: LiteLLM least-busy: 23.3 req/s, p95 849 ms. Client round-robin: 20.7 req/s, p95 1206 ms. One backend: 16.7 req/s.
tests.result_zh: LiteLLM least-busy：23.3 req/s、p95 849 ms。用戶端輪流：20.7 req/s、p95 1206 ms。單一後端：16.7 req/s。
tests.why_en: Does LiteLLM beat splitting the work by hand?
tests.note_en: Real: 2 PRO6000 GPUs, 3 runs each. LiteLLM 'least busy' vs sending requests to each GPU in turn. An earlier run gave +27% at 4 users and +1% at 8.
tests.note_zh: 真機：PRO6000 兩張 GPU，各跑 3 次。LiteLLM「找最閒的」對比自己輪流送。較早一次測到 4 人 +27%、8 人 +1%。

tests.crit_en: The extra delay is small next to a real answer
tests.crit_zh: 多出的延遲遠小於一次回答的時間
tests.needs_en: Mac only, instant fake backend, 3 repeats. At 8 requests at once the gateway queues (p50 41 ms) because one worker saturates; the PRO6000 gateway is started without --num_workers. Real model replies take seconds, so 5 ms is small; it matters for many short requests.
tests.needs_zh: 僅在 Mac 用「立即回應」的假後端，重複 3 次。同時 8 個請求時閘道會排隊（p50 41 ms），因為單一 worker 飽和；PRO6000 閘道啟動時沒設 --num_workers。真實模型回應要數秒，5 ms 相對很小；請求很短又很多時才看得出來。

history.en: Listed.
history.zh: 已列入。

history.en: Instant fake backend, direct vs through LiteLLM v1.110.0, 3 repeats. 1 at a time: p50 0.11 -> 5.45 ms (+5.3), p95 +6.9. Streaming: first token +5.7 ms, +0.5 ms per chunk. 8 at once: p50 0.57 -> 40.9 ms; gateway tops out near 187 req/s (direct 12,700).
history.zh: 立即回應的假後端，直連對經 LiteLLM v1.110.0，重複 3 次。一次 1 個：p50 0.11 → 5.45 ms（+5.3）、p95 +6.9。串流：首字 +5.7 ms、每段 +0.5 ms。一次 8 個：p50 0.57 → 40.9 ms；閘道上限約 187 req/s（直連 12,700）。

history.en: Relabelled: these numbers come from fake backends on a Mac, not from GPUs. They test the gateway logic only. Real-machine retest is in 1a.
history.zh: 改標：這些數字來自 Mac 上的假後端，不是 GPU，只驗證閘道邏輯。真機重測在 1a。

tests.result_en: Adds about 5 ms per request (p50 +5.3, p95 +6.9), 5.7 ms to the first token and 0.5 ms per streamed chunk. One worker tops out near 190 requests/s.
tests.result_zh: 每個請求約多 5 ms（p50 +5.3、p95 +6.9）；首字多 5.7 ms，串流每段多 0.5 ms。單一 worker 上限約每秒 190 個請求。
tests.why_en: Does the middle layer slow answers down?
tests.why_zh: 中間這層會讓回答變慢嗎？
tests.note_en: Fake setup: about 5 ms. We tried it on the real machines too, but the link to them jitters by tens of ms, so the number was unusable and is not shown.
tests.note_zh: 模擬環境約 5 毫秒。真機也試過，但連到機器的網路本身會抖動數十毫秒，數字不能用，所以不放。

tests.crit_en: Find where more people stops helping
tests.crit_zh: 找出人再多也沒有更好的轉折點
tests.needs_en: Fake backends on a Mac (0.20 s base, +25% per extra request in flight), 3 repeats per level, concurrency 1 to 64. Not a GPU measurement; the real curve needs the real pair (1a).
tests.needs_zh: Mac 上的假後端（基礎 0.20 秒，每多一個在途請求慢 25%），每個併發數重複 3 次，併發 1 到 64。不是 GPU 量測；真實曲線要等真機成對（1a）。

history.en: Listed.
history.zh: 已列入。

history.en: Simulated, concurrency 1/2/4/8/16/32/64: one backend 4.9/7.8/11.2/14.1/16.5/18.2/19.0 req/s; LiteLLM over two 4.4/8.5/14.5/20.6/27.4/32.2/35.5 req/s. Gain 0.9x at 1, 1.46x at 8, 1.87x at 64; p95 at 64: 3357 vs 1779 ms. One failed request at 16.

Real: 1 card vs 2 cards through LiteLLM at 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 users: 1.21x, 1.31x, 1.32x, 1.76x, 1.77x, 1.79x. At 32 users the longest wait drops from 13.5 s to 7.5 s. The 1-user figure is noise: one person can only use one card.
history.zh: 真機：1 張卡 vs 經 LiteLLM 的 2 張卡，1、2、4、8、16、32 人：1.21、1.31、1.32、1.76、1.77、1.79 倍。32 人時最久的等待從 13.5 秒降到 7.5 秒。1 人那個數字是雜訊：一個人同時只用得到一張卡。

tests.result_en: Simulated: gain grows with load, 0.9x at 1 request (gateway overhead) to 1.87x at 64.
tests.result_zh: 模擬：負載越高優勢越大，1 個請求時 0.9 倍（閘道開銷），64 個時 1.87 倍。
tests.why_en: Does it keep up when many people ask?
tests.why_zh: 很多人同時問，撐得住嗎？
tests.res_en: Gain levels off at about 1.8x from 8 users
tests.res_zh: 從 8 人起，增益停在約 1.8 倍
tests.note_en: Real: 1 card vs 2 cards through LiteLLM at 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 users: 1.21x, 1.31x, 1.32x, 1.76x, 1.77x, 1.79x. At 32 users the longest wait drops from 13.5 s to 7.5 s. The 1-user figure is noise: one person can only use one card.
tests.note_zh: 真機：1 張卡 vs 經 LiteLLM 的 2 張卡，1、2、4、8、16、32 人：1.21、1.31、1.32、1.76、1.77、1.79 倍。32 人時最久的等待從 13.5 秒降到 7.5 秒。1 人那個數字是雜訊：一個人同時只用得到一張卡。

tests.needs_en: Keep least-busy, which is today's PRO6000 setting. Simulated backends only, same load as 1b; recheck on the real GPUs in 1a and 1d.
tests.needs_zh: 維持 least-busy，也就是 PRO6000 現行設定。僅模擬後端，負載與 1b 相同；要在 1a、1d 用真 GPU 再確認。

history.en: Listed.
history.zh: 已列入。

history.en: Same simulated load for all three. least-busy 23.3 req/s (p95 849); simple-shuffle 20.9 (p95 1292); latency-based 16.5 (p95 975), about the same as a single backend (16.7).
history.zh: 三者用同一個模擬負載。least-busy 23.3 req/s（p95 849）；simple-shuffle 20.9（p95 1292）；latency-based 16.5（p95 975），和單一後端（16.7）差不多。

history.en: Relabelled: these numbers come from fake backends on a Mac, not from GPUs. They test the gateway logic only. Real-machine retest is in 1a.
history.zh: 改標：這些數字來自 Mac 上的假後端，不是 GPU，只驗證閘道邏輯。真機重測在 1a。

history.en: Real: 4 and 8 users, 3 runs each. At 8 users: least busy 3.72 requests/s, by hand 3.33, random 2.91, latency-based 2.07. No failures.
history.zh: 真機：4 人與 8 人，各跑 3 次。8 人時：找最閒的 3.72、人工輪流 3.33、隨機 2.91、看回應快慢 2.07（每秒請求數）。全部沒有失敗。

tests.result_en: least-busy wins: 23.3 req/s, p95 849 ms. simple-shuffle: 20.9 req/s, p95 1292 ms (same as round-robin). latency-based: 16.5 req/s, p95 975 ms (no better than one backend).
tests.result_zh: least-busy 最好：23.3 req/s、p95 849 ms。simple-shuffle：20.9 req/s、p95 1292 ms（和輪流相同）。latency-based：16.5 req/s、p95 975 ms（不比單一後端好）。
tests.why_en: Which rule shares the work best?
tests.res_zh: 「找最閒的」最好；「看回應快慢」最差
tests.note_en: Real: 4 and 8 users, 3 runs each. At 8 users: least busy 3.72 requests/s, by hand 3.33, random 2.91, latency-based 2.07. No failures.
tests.note_zh: 真機：4 人與 8 人，各跑 3 次。8 人時：找最閒的 3.72、人工輪流 3.33、隨機 2.91、看回應快慢 2.07（每秒請求數）。全部沒有失敗。

tests.needs_en: Needs a third backend (HPE GPU, not arrived).
tests.needs_zh: 需要第三個後端（HPE GPU 尚未到）。

history.en: Waiting for HPE GPU.
history.zh: 等待 HPE GPU。

tests.why_en: Does a new machine just work?
tests.why_zh: 加一台機器，直接就能用嗎？
tests.note_en: Needs a third machine. Waiting for the HPE GPU.
tests.note_zh: 需要第三台機器，在等 HPE GPU。

groups.mean_en: Check that two machines behind one door really do more work.
groups.mean_zh: 確認兩台機器接在同一個入口後，真的做得比較多。
groups.big_en: more work with 2 cards when many people ask
groups.big_zh: 很多人同時用時，兩張卡的處理量
groups.sum_en: 2 cards do 1.3x to 1.8x of what 1 card does, and the longest wait nearly halves at 32 users (13.5 s to 7.5 s). 'Least busy' beats splitting by hand by 7% to 12%.
groups.sum_zh: 兩張卡做到一張卡的 1.3 到 1.8 倍，32 人時最久的等待幾乎減半（13.5 秒降到 7.5 秒）。「找最閒的」比人工輪流分配多做 7% 到 12%。

groups.benefit_en: A machine dies or a prompt is too long: users should not notice.
groups.benefit_zh: 機器掛了或輸入太長，使用者要無感。

tests.crit_en: No request fails; back to normal within 30 s
tests.crit_zh: 沒有請求失敗；30 秒內恢復
tests.needs_en: Real run on PRO6000 GPU1 + GPU7 (llama.cpp), LiteLLM on a Mac via SSH tunnel, 8 requests at once for 95 s. At 25 s the GPU7 container was killed, at about 57 s started again. The Mac fake-backend drill (about 700 requests) gave the same picture.
tests.needs_zh: 真機：PRO6000 GPU1＋GPU7（llama.cpp），LiteLLM 在 Mac 上經 SSH tunnel，同時 8 個請求跑 95 秒。第 25 秒關掉 GPU7 的容器，約第 57 秒再啟動。Mac 假後端演練（約 700 個請求）的結果一致。

history.en: Listed.
history.zh: 已列入。

history.en: Local LiteLLM v1.110.0, 2 fake backends, 4 clients for 70 s, one backend killed at 15 s and restarted at 40 s. 1 retry: 2 failed in each of 3 runs (in flight). 3 retries: 0 failed in 2 runs.
history.zh: 本機 LiteLLM v1.110.0、2 個假後端、4 個用戶端跑 70 秒，第 15 秒關掉一個、第 40 秒重啟。重試 1 次：3 次各有 2 個失敗（在途）。重試 3 次：2 次皆 0 失敗。

history.en: Real GPUs: with 3 retries 728 requests, 0 failed through the kill and the restart. With 1 retry 656 requests, 5 failed: 3 within 1.2 s of the kill, 2 about 32 s later when the restarted backend was still loading. Keep num_retries at 3 or more.
history.zh: 真機：重試 3 次，728 個請求，關機與重啟全程 0 失敗。重試 1 次，656 個請求失敗 5 個：3 個在關機後 1.2 秒內，2 個在約 32 秒後（重啟的後端還在載入）。num_retries 建議 3 以上。

tests.result_en: Real GPUs: 0 of 728 failed (3 retries); 5 of 656 with 1 retry
tests.result_zh: 真機：重試 3 次，728 個 0 失敗；重試 1 次，656 個失敗 5 個
tests.res_zh: 不會：728 個請求 0 失敗
tests.note_en: Real machine. With 3 retries nothing failed; with 1 retry 5 of 656 failed. Raise retries from 1 to 3.
tests.note_zh: 真機。重試 3 次沒有失敗；重試 1 次 656 個失敗 5 個。建議重試次數從 1 調到 3。

tests.crit_en: Users notice nothing when the gateway restarts (needs two gateways)
tests.crit_zh: 入口重啟時使用者沒感覺（要有兩個入口）
tests.needs_en: Two gateway instances plus Redis for shared cooldown and limits. Pin the image version.
tests.needs_zh: 兩個閘道實例加 Redis，共用冷卻與限流；固定 image 版本。

history.en: Listed.
history.zh: 已列入。

history.en: Real: gateway killed under 6 busy users, started again 25 s later. With one gateway every request failed for about 31 s. With a second gateway the client tried it and none failed.
history.zh: 真機：6 人使用中把入口關掉，25 秒後再開。只有一個入口時，約 31 秒內每個請求都失敗。有第二個入口，客戶端改連它，全部成功。

tests.why_en: Is there a backup for the middle layer?
tests.why_zh: 中間這層壞了，有備援嗎？
tests.note_en: Real: gateway killed under 6 busy users, started again 25 s later. With one gateway every request failed for about 31 s. With a second gateway the client tried it and none failed.
tests.note_zh: 真機：6 人使用中把入口關掉，25 秒後再開。只有一個入口時，約 31 秒內每個請求都失敗。有第二個入口，客戶端改連它，全部成功。
tests.res_en: One gateway: about 31 s of no service. Two gateways: 0 of 652 requests failed
tests.res_zh: 只有一個入口：約 31 秒沒服務。兩個入口：652 個請求 0 個失敗

tests.crit_en: A long question goes to a machine that can take it
tests.crit_zh: 長問題交給撐得住的機器
tests.needs_en: Fallback between the long and balanced groups.
tests.needs_zh: 在 long 與 balanced 兩組之間設 fallback。

history.en: Listed.
history.zh: 已列入。

tests.why_en: Does it go to a machine that can take it?
tests.why_zh: 會交給撐得住的機器嗎？

groups.mean_en: Check that a broken machine does not stop the service.
groups.mean_zh: 確認一台機器壞掉時，服務不會中斷。
groups.big_en: requests lost when a machine breaks
groups.big_zh: 一台機器壞掉時掉的請求數
groups.sum_en: 728 requests ran while one machine was off: none failed. If the gateway itself restarts, one copy is down for about 31 s; with two copies nothing is lost (0 of 652).
groups.sum_zh: 一台機器關掉時跑了 728 個請求：全部成功。入口本身重啟時，只有一個會斷約 31 秒；有兩個就不掉請求（652 個 0 失敗）。

groups.benefit_en: Keys, limits, monitoring and our Harness on one address.
groups.benefit_zh: 金鑰、額度、監控與 Harness 都走同一個入口。

tests.crit_en: 3 apps, 1 address, each with its own key
tests.crit_zh: 3 個應用、1 個網址、各用各的金鑰
tests.needs_en: Run on a Mac: LiteLLM v1.109.1 with a Postgres database in Docker, fake model backends. Key rules do not depend on the GPU, so fake backends are enough for this test. The shared PRO6000 gateway has no database, so it cannot do this yet.
tests.needs_zh: 在 Mac 上跑：LiteLLM v1.109.1 加 Docker 裡的 Postgres 資料庫，模型後端用假的。金鑰規則跟 GPU 無關，所以假後端就夠。共用的 PRO6000 閘道沒有資料庫，目前還做不到這件事。

history.en: No database on the gateway.
history.zh: 閘道沒有資料庫。

history.en: 3 keys from one address. No key and a wrong key: refused (401). App 1 and app 2 keys: accepted (200). App 3, allowed only model m2: m2 accepted (200), m refused (403).
history.zh: 一個網址發 3 把金鑰。沒金鑰、錯金鑰：拒絕（401）。應用 1、2 的金鑰：通過（200）。應用 3 只允許 m2：m2 通過（200）、m 被拒（403）。

tests.why_en: Does everyone use one address, each with their own key?
tests.why_zh: 大家用同一個網址、各用各的金鑰嗎？
tests.res_en: Yes: 3 apps, 1 address, wrong key refused
tests.res_zh: 可以：3 個應用、1 個網址，錯的金鑰被拒絕
tests.note_en: Tested on a Mac with a database. The model side was fake because key rules do not depend on the GPU. The shared PRO6000 gateway has no database yet.
tests.note_zh: 在 Mac 加資料庫測，模型端用假的，因為金鑰規則跟 GPU 無關。共用的 PRO6000 閘道還沒有資料庫。

tests.crit_en: One app's limit does not touch the others
tests.crit_zh: 一個應用的限額不影響其他
tests.needs_en: Same Mac setup as 3a. App 1 was capped at 3 requests a minute, app 2 had no cap. Spend per key is recorded in the database. Budgets in money were not tried because the fake backend has no price.
